First, enroll all identities in a beacon lottery: VRF draws 5% each epoch; each drawn identity submits proof within 2 epochs.

Then, 7 jurors verify; absence freezes rewards 6 epochs; a second miss forfeits 50% stake, the reef of hoarded accounts cannot hide.

Finally, costs: 1,000 clones lock 120,000; absence penalties average 6,000 a round, 60,000 in ten. The zenith: hoarding pays only if you work every account, every round, like a vine tended.
